PC: Interventions to be discontinued as care transitions to comfort--IV fluids, tube feeds, ventilator, labs
Interventions to be continued/started: medications for pain, shortness of breath, other symptoms, mouth care to prevent dry mouth
SBP: Patient disposition—staying in hospital v. going to outside facility (hospice)
ICS: Stated respect for patient’s decision makers
Fired a “warning shot”, such as “I’m afraid I have some bad news” .
Attempted to elicit patient’s treatment goals
Concluded with a review of what had been decided
PROF: Made recommendation before eliciting patient’s preferences
Asked surrogates what THEY would want to do
